http_host/ — the std HTTP surface's host rows (the rut/http plan): a
pure declaration surface. The embedding Rust binds the bodies
(`http::pkg()` / `pkg_with`); the `http` package
wraps them in the `Response` class.

The registration scope IS the package name; the use path spells it
too (`use http_host::{ http_get, http_status }`).
name: http_host
